- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER generated the highest revenue in TW at £4.6k, followed by WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER at £3.2k.
- JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT led unit sales in TW with 1,405 units, while ASSORTED COLOURS SILK FAN achieved 1,333 units.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER recorded the most orders in TW with 59, compared to WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER with 57 orders.
- Total revenue in TW reached £36.9k across 626 orders, representing a WoW increase of 120.6%.
- CHILDS BREAKFAST SET DOLLY GIRL showed the strongest WoW revenue growth at 9,039%, followed by PAPER CHAIN KIT SKULLS at 3,983.9%.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER achieved 1,209 units sold in TW, the third highest unit volume after JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT and ASSORTED COLOURS SILK FAN.
- Total unit volume in TW was 14,987 units across all products, with PAPER BUNTING RETRO SPOTS contributing 846 units.
- CHILDS BREAKFAST SET SPACEBOY demonstrated significant WoW revenue growth of 3,144.7%, indicating strong momentum compared to LW.
